# `MC_fsOpen`

Open or create a file according to the supplied flags and access mode.

## Prototype

```c
M_Int32 MC_fsOpen(M_Char *name, M_Int32 flag, M_Int32 aMode);
```

## Usage

### Parameters

| Name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `name` | File path in the selected install profile's filesystem namespace. |
| `flag` | Open flags. |
| `aMode` | Access mode. |

### Return value

A file descriptor or the provider-defined failure value.
